name: Grassy Expanse
design_intent: Spread-out 3760px grass island: two trampoline floors split by an OPEN 960px void pit (no bridge), three boost-only elevated pads (bubblegum shoulders + a spring THRONE over the pit). The 960px pit exceeds both the ~395px zero-boost trampoline drift AND the ~850px boost-then-coast reach, so sustained flight is MANDATORY to cross; every upper pad beats a spring bounce's 480px apex, so the jetpack is mandatory to traverse; super earns the cross-map and the throne. (v1 §4: mid-pit spring bridge removed, pit widened 720->960 to restore flight-required horizontal traversal.)
